columns.name: ID
columns.description: A unique station identifier. NOTE: Extremely long IDs may not display correctly on this page but should be correct if this dataset is exported or accessed through the API.

columns.name: Timestamp
columns.description: The date and time the record was recorded.

columns.name: Address
columns.description: The street address of the station. This value is not available after 7/7/2019.

columns.name: Total Docks
columns.description: Total docks in the station.  Each dock can accommodate one bicycle.

columns.name: Docks in Service
columns.description: Excludes docks taken out of service.  Calculated as the number of docks reported as containing available bicycles or available to receive returned bicycles.

columns.name: Available Docks
columns.description: Number of docks available to receive a returned bicycle.

columns.name: Available Bikes
columns.description: Number of bicycles available to be rented.

columns.name: Percent Full
columns.description: Percentage of the docks in service containing an available bike. N/A (denominator is zero) values are indicated by either blank or -1.

columns.name: Status
columns.description: The status of the station.  Stations "In Service" are available for use.

columns.name: Location
columns.description: The location of the station in a format that allows for creating maps in this data portal and performing some types of geographic analysis.

columns.name: Record
columns.description: A combination of ID (indicating station) and Timestamp (indicating when the record was recorded) to uniquely identify the record
